title: Missing Number
description: Given an array `nums` containing `n` distinct numbers in the range `[0, n]`, return the only number in the range that is missing from the array.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
hints: Use XOR property: XOR all indices 0..n and all array values.
Numbers present in both will cancel to 0.
The remaining value is the missing number in O(n) time and O(1) space.

starter_code.python:
# Missing Number
import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data: return
    # Write your solution here
    pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    ans = n
    for i, x in enumerate(nums):
        ans ^= i ^ x
    print(ans)
